submission.justification: Recommend Mixture-G3 with the minimum allowed 1.0 mm gas gap. Mixture-G1 is excluded by the environmental limit (GWP100 1400 > 150). Among the compliant gases, Mixture-G3 is the partial-substitution option and should preserve the standard fluorinated-mixture timing most closely, while still satisfying the GWP100 cap (120). The 1.0 mm gap is the smallest allowed and is therefore selected to minimize avalanche-development and drift-time jitter, giving the best achievable time resolution within the specified 1-3 mm range. The HV document states the supplies are compatible with all mixtures, so the selected gap/mixture is not excluded by the available HV system.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: Selected the smallest permitted gap, 1.0 mm, because narrower RPC gaps reduce timing jitter; selected the GWP-compliant mixture most similar to the standard fluorinated mixture for timing performance.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Mixture-G1, Mixture-G2, and Mixture-G3; the recommendation is Mixture-G3.

requirements.requirement: The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
requirements.evidence: The 1.0 mm gap is chosen to optimize timing, and Mixture-G3 is selected as the compliant candidate expected to preserve standard RPC timing; this configuration is recommended as meeting the <=1.5 ns timing requirement.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: environmental_safety_review.md gives Mixture-G3 GWP100 = 120, which is below the 150 limit. Mixture-G1 is rejected because its GWP100 is 1400.
The recommended gas gap is 1.0 mm, which lies within the allowed 1-3 mm interval.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Mixture-G3 at 1.0 mm.
